name: Amy's Organic Butternut Squash Soup (Silky Puree)
whyItWorks: Pureed smooth with organic butternut squash, carrots, and light ginger without cream, butter, or seeds. The silky texture delivers soothing potassium and soluble beta-carotene without mechanical friction.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Warm in a saucepan. Pairs gently with a slice of toasted sourdough.
